lines: The story trips pick up the upgrades and what's on the way; once the Power Bomb opens everything, a cleanup trip per area gets the rest. Finish before the capsule to Itorash.
Positions from MapGenie's map; directions from Gameranx's guides and walkthrough.

p.x: The Charge Beam, then the grey E.M.M.I. for the Spider Magnet, and Corpius for the Phantom Cloak.

p.h: 2. Cataris and Dairon: Morph Ball and Varia

p.x: Thermal Flow switches through Cataris, the Wide Beam in Dairon, the green E.M.M.I. for the Morph Ball, the Varia Suit back in Artaria, then Kraid.

p.h: 3. Dairon and Burenia: Bomb to Grapple

p.x: The Bomb in Dairon, the Flash Shift in Burenia, the yellow E.M.M.I. for the Speed Booster, and the Grapple Beam back in Artaria.
After Drogyga: Super Missiles, the Plasma Beam in Elun, the Spin Boost, the blue E.M.M.I. for Ice Missiles, and the Pulse Radar.
Escue for the Storm Missile, then the Space Jump past the Twin Robot Chozo Soldiers.
Into Burenia's depths for the Gravity Suit, Experiment Z-57 in Cataris, then the Screw Attack in thawed Artaria.

lines: A Chozo Statue in the bottom-left corner of Artaria, once you've slipped past the first working E.M.M.I. It's in AR-03.
Right of the starting room, under the first Network Station: slide under once you have the Charge Beam. The tank is in AR-01.
Destroy the grey E.M.M.I.: open the Thermal doors with the Charge Beam, take the Omega Beam from the Central Unit and blast its core. It's in AR-05.
The tall E.M.M.I. Zone room covered in blue walls: at the top, shoot through the wall. You pass it right after the first E.M.M.I. falls. The tank is in AR-06.
Corpius's reward (see Bosses), past the alien door at the top of the tall E.M.M.I. Zone shaft. It's in AR-10.
A Chozo Statue in Dairon's dark section, once you've restored the power at its generator. It's in DA-05.
Destroy the green E.M.M.I.: break the Wide Beam cover above the Save Station to reach the Central Unit. It's in CA-04.
Right below the Red Teleportal, where the one in Cataris brings you. The tank is in AR-11.
Left of the upper-left Save Station by the Red Teleportal, through a Morph Ball gap. On the way to the Varia Suit. It's in AR-11.

From the Red Teleportal (from Cataris), go left past the Save Station through the Morph Ball gap. Throw the Thermal Flow switch and run up through the exploding rooms to the Chozo Statue. It's in AR-11.
In the vents right outside the Save Station before Kraid. The tank is in CA-04.
Kraid's reward (see Bosses). With the Varia Suit, go through the left door by the Ammo Recharge Station and follow the cave. It's in CA-03.
Restore the second generator past the E.M.M.I. Zone, then go into the room left of the upper Save Station. It's in DA-07.
Deeper into Burenia past the Network Station (shoot through the floor by the fans to find the way on). It's in BU-03.
By the fans after the Network Station: shoot through the floor to find the hidden path. It's in BU-02.

From the Green Teleportal (from Ghavoran), drop to the lower underwater levels, break the Storm Missile crate and Space Jump up. The tank is in BU-04.

Golzuna's reward (see Bosses), up the long Morph Ball passage by the Green Teleportal. It's in GH-10.

Through the Network Station's upper-right door, the room to the right: from the ledge, Speed Boost, store a Shinespark and bomb through. As a Morph Ball, jump and spark down through the Speed Booster blocks. The tank is in HA-07.

tags: Weak point: Its face, and the glowing tail while it's invisible

lines: Missiles and charged shots to the face; jump its tail strikes.

When it charges a big attack, slide under and be ready to counter (melee as it flashes).
Use the Spider Magnet wall that appears to dodge its poison breath, but drop off before it slams the wall.

tags: Weak point: Inside his open mouth

lines: Shoot his eyes and mouth to make him open up, then fill the mouth with Missiles. Shoot his spit and claws for health and Missiles.

tags: Weak point: The core, once the water's drained

lines: Shoot the blue orbs for pickups and jump the tentacles when they shake.

With the core exposed, Missile it and counter the tentacle it lashes with.
At the top of Burenia, after the Grapple Beam and a trip through Ferenia.

tags: Weak point: Ice Missiles while its shield is down

lines: Its electric shield is up most of the time. After it rams a wall the shield drops: unload Ice Missiles or charged shots.

Its final form is a big X: shoot it and absorb what comes out.
Down the spire on Ferenia's far right; Pulse Radar shows the way. Gives the Storm Missile.
Missiles to the head. Jump to the far corner as it sweeps its claws, and wait out its pink beam before moving.
When it fires the big beam, get under its head and counter the bite.
Second phase: when it plants its tentacles round the room, Storm Missile all five points. Space Jump through its wind and swipes.
At the bottom of Cataris, through a red pustule by the Network Station, once you have the Gravity Suit.

tags: Weak point: Its back (or head in the middle form)

lines: It changes shape twice. Slide under it when it rears up and shoot its back.

tags: Weak point: Missiles and charged shots, and counters

lines: Flash Shift away from its dives and slams; wall-jump to get over it when cornered.
When its blade flashes, counter. When it glows red, dodge.
Shielded ones: counter the shield as it flashes yellow to break it (the Elite one's needs a Grapple pull too).
Several mini-bosses: a Chozo Soldier guards Elun, a shielded one waits in frozen Artaria, and the Elite Chozo Soldier is in Hanubia. The last regular one gives the Power Bomb.
Counter when it draws its blade back and flashes; jump or Flash Shift over it when it glows red.
With two, focus on one at a time.
Mini-bosses, sometimes in pairs.

tags: Weak point: Counters, then everything you have

lines: Learn the counters: his red-glowing dash punch can be countered, and each counter opens him up for big damage.
Shoot or dodge his dark sphere. Duck or morph under his screen-wide beam, then counter.
He grows wings in the second phase: stay close, Space Jump over his beam and Flash Shift under his lunges.
After he falls, finish him with the Omega Beam, then you have three minutes to reach your ship.
The final boss, past the capsule at the top of Hanubia. There's no going back afterwards.
You can't hurt an E.M.M.I. normally. Find its zone's Central Unit, destroy it, and you get the Omega Cannon for a while.
Lure the E.M.M.I. somewhere with room, rapid-fire to strip its faceplate, then charge the Omega Cannon and blast its core.
Each one gives an upgrade: Spider Magnet, Morph Ball, Speed Booster, Ice Missile and Wave Beam.
When it grabs you, press Melee at the exact flash to break free. The window is very short.
Use the Phantom Cloak to stay unseen, and leave the zone through any door to end the chase.
23 upgrades, 8 Energy Tanks, 16 Energy Parts (four make a tank), 75 Missile Tanks, 11 Missile+ Tanks and 13 Power Bomb Tanks.
The map remembers every item you've seen; the map screen can highlight every icon of a type.
Run with the Speed Booster until it kicks in, then press Down to store the charge. Jump and press a direction to launch.
You can keep the charge while sliding, and store it again by landing a Shinespark on a slope and pressing Down.
As a Morph Ball you can launch too, through narrow passages.
The steps for Shinespark items work, but the timing is hard to follow from text. Each one's page suggests a YouTube search for a video.
Press Melee as an enemy flashes just before it hits you. Countered enemies drop more, and bosses take big damage.
Most bosses have at least one attack you can counter; it's usually the quickest way through.
The capsule at the top of Hanubia takes you to Itorash and the final fight. Finish your 100% cleanup first.
Dread's own map has no room outlines, so these maps are simplified: the areas are cut into rooms at their doors and drawn on a coarse grid.
Item positions are exact; room shapes are approximate, and the big E.M.M.I. Zones are mostly one room each.
